h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gaya

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gaya

items.pText: Gaya and nearby Bodh Gaya draw pilgrims from across India and the world, and the area has monasteries, residential schools and guest houses as well as the usual town schools and colonies. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for all of these from our factory in Vasai, about 1,380 km away. We send each order to Bihar by road and install it with our team or a dealer.

Residential schools and monastery campuses use their play areas differently from a day school. Children are on site all day, every day, including weekends and holidays. The equipment gets many more hours of use, so sturdy frames, few loose parts and a clear maintenance routine matter most. Gaya's summers are also fiercely hot, so plan shade over the play area and keep outdoor play to the cooler hours.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Equipment for residential schools and campuses

c: For heavy daily use, choose pieces built from galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts, which carry our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year, so keep a simple monthly check of swing hangers, spring riders and merry-go-round bearings. Spread the activities around so that children do not crowd one slide. A mix of climbers, swings and a multi play station keeps more children busy at once.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,380 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What equipment holds up best in a residential school?
items.a: Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts with few loose components. Plan enough pieces to spread the children out, and follow a regular check of moving parts such as hangers and bearings.

items.q: Can monasteries and guest houses in Bodh Gaya order from you?
items.a: Yes. Any campus, school or guest house in Gaya and Bodh Gaya can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our team or a dealer.

items.q: How should we plan for Gaya's summer heat?
items.a: Place slides and decks in shade where you can, and use rubber flooring instead of sand, which gets very hot. Schools can also move outdoor play to the early morning in May and June.
